routes.claim: The checkpoint exactly commits one unchanged complete v3.2 history at creation.
routes.passCondition: Every v3.2 record is loaded in one validated chain read, equal snapshots bracket the read, and exact rebuild equals the presented checkpoint.
routes.primarySurface: focused execution against synthetic v3.2 ledgers
routes.counterevidence: missing record, changed bracket snapshot, altered checkpoint, or origin rebuild mismatch
routes.secondarySurfaceIfNeeded: fresh-process exact rebuild and source/contract inspection
routes.observedEvidence: Focused v3.3 execution exact-rebuilt checkpoints from one v3.2 readAll call bracketed by equal snapshots; a changed final bracket failed with LEDGER_MOVED_DURING_PRESENTATION.
routes.namedSeam: v3.2 local filesystem and non-atomic bracketing

routes.claim: A fresh process can self-validate the minimized checkpoint after the origin ledger is absent.
routes.passCondition: After bounded removal of the synthetic origin root, a new process validates the exact checkpoint while origin re-verification fails.
routes.primarySurface: fresh-process reload after verified synthetic-root removal
routes.counterevidence: validator reads the ledger path, embeds the root, or accepts a drifted digest
routes.observedEvidence: After bounded removal of the synthetic v3.2 namespace, a fresh process validated the exact checkpoint and audit while checkpoint origin verification failed.

routes.claim: A presented checkpoint classifies later v3.2 histories exactly and fails closed on abnormal continuity.
routes.passCondition: Held-out exact, forward, rollback, fork, identity, absent, and corrupt cases produce only their specified typed classifications and zero actions.
routes.counterevidence: misclassification, ignored extra state, authority-bearing output, or accepted corruption
routes.secondarySurfaceIfNeeded: fresh-process audit rebuild and schema closure
routes.observedEvidence: Held-out exact forward rollback fork identity absent corrupt-ledger and invalid-configuration cases produced only their specified classifications and zero actions.
routes.namedSeam: classification is relative to the caller-presented checkpoint

routes.claim: A retained original checkpoint detects a whole-ledger replacement, but joint checkpoint-ledger replacement remains possible.
routes.passCondition: The original checkpoint holds a self-consistent rewritten ledger while a checkpoint regenerated from that replacement audits it as exact.
routes.counterevidence: original checkpoint accepts rewritten history as exact or module claims original-history proof
routes.observedEvidence: The original checkpoint held a same-manifest whole-ledger replacement; a checkpoint regenerated from the replacement audited that replacement as exact and still refused original-history proof.
routes.namedSeam: checkpoint retention and origin are unauthenticated

routes.claim: Public artifacts retain only minimized references/timeline and grant no consequential authority.
routes.passCondition: Closed schemas, runtime outputs, and contract omit raw review material and fix review-only, hold-unresolved, zero-action truth fields.
routes.counterevidence: raw actors, notes, paths, complete outcomes, execution authority, benefit, learning, promotion, or CANON claims
routes.secondarySurfaceIfNeeded: module-contract verifier and source import scan
routes.observedEvidence: Runtime key scans closed schemas contract validation and source inspection showed reference-only public history with fixed hold-unresolved zero-action no-authority fields.
routes.namedSeam: pseudonymous references are not authenticated identities
